ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in child care programs and follow the money trail to determine the extent of the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in child care programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money trail, we can determine the extent of the issue and identify potential suspects.
